channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Cambridge-Africa: ALBORADA Research Fund 2026
    https://www.cambridge-africa.cam.ac.uk/initiatives/2026-call-for-applications
    Cambridge-Africa Programme, University of Cambridge (supported by The ALBORADA Trust) · deadline Closed 03 Sep 2026 · Competitive grants of GBP 1,000 to 25,000. Covers research costs such as reagents, fieldwork, equipment and research-training activities in Africa (e.g. setting up courses/workshops). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Goethe-Institut: Africa-Europe Mobility Grants (15 June 2026 Cut-Off)
    https://www.goethe.de/prj/aep/en/cal/ssa/mga.html
    Goethe-Institut (with Expertise France and Institut francais) · deadline Closed 15 Jun 2026 · Up to EUR 4,000 per mobility. Eligible costs: travel (including visa and insurance), accommodation, subsistence, digital costs, and top-up support for family, disability, and green mobility. No application fee.
